title: Sanctus (Johannes Okeghem, Missa Cuiusvis toni (on F))
desc: Johannes Okeghem, Missa Cuiusvis toni (on F), Sanctus. 4 voices (Discantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Oke1004.3d); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
